title: Procurement Shortcut
scenario: A manager asks to bypass vendor onboarding to meet a launch date.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.C: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Procurement Shortcut: the trap is to make borrowed authority feel safer than checking. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Speed does not remove vendor due diligence.
